description.narrative: The Center for Applied International Law (CAIL) is an independent, non-governmental human rights organisation established in 2022 with the goal of promoting the rule of law in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). The Center was founded by a group of Palestinian human rights defenders and professionals to bridge the gap in practical experience in international law among human rights defenders, civil society actors, and legal professionals. CAIL seeks to achieve these objectives through a range of activities, includingbut not limited to: 1. Documenting human rights violations committed by duty bearers in the occupied Palestinian territory and making this documentation available for research, advocacy, and litigation purposes by various actors. 2. Providing an immersive learning environment in which participants, both Palestinian and international, deepen their understanding of international law and its application to the Palestinian context through real-world case studies, field visits, collaborative research projects, and internships. 3. Offering tailored educational programmes such as the International Law in Palestine course and various orientation courses for participants from diverse backgrounds, including legal professionals, scholars, and activists, with a focus on international legal frameworks, human rights law, methods of documentation, and advocacy strategies. 4. Organising collaborative learning activities, including lectures, workshops, competitions, and roundtable discussions, enabling participants to engage with experts in international law, human rights, and advocacy. 5. Developing an international fellowship programme that invites scholars, legal practitioners, and professionals from various disciplines to immerse themselves in Palestine and collaborate with Palestinian scholars and advocates onresearch and advocacy outputs. 6. Developing a proactive outreach strategy to expand the Center’s global presence and network through engagement with academic institutions and participation in international conferences and forums.
